statement.p: Calculate the flux of the vector field \vec F = -6\vec i + 4x^{2}\vec j - 3\vec k, through the square of side 2 in the plane y=8, centered on the y-axis, with sides parallel to the x and z axes, and oriented in the positive y-direction.

static.solution: \vec j-component, and since d\vec A = \vec j dx\,dz on the square, S, we have \hbox{Flux } = \int_S(-6\vec i + 4x^{2}\vec j - 3\vec k)\cdot d\vec A =\int_{-1}^{1}\int_{-1}^{1} 4x^{2}\vec j\cdot \vec j dx\,dz =\int_{-1}^{1}4\frac{x^3}3\bigg|_{-1}^1\,dz = \frac{8}{3}\cdot 2 = \frac{16}{3}.
